name: False Frights
storyline:
You slipped, fell, bumped your head, blacked out, and woke up here - an awkward collage of Freddy's locations, filled to the brim with various animatronic characters previously considered to be unfiction.

Turns out, they aren't fake. They're real. And they're out for blood.
summary: False Frights is a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame by @bikewithnoseat that adds many rumored "Hoax" characters in a roguelike structure. Pick and choose what animatronics you add to your office before facing off against a boss, in a classic office defense gameplay loop with many unique mechanics and twists.
